characters.name: Tony Stark / Iron Man
characters.description: Genius billionaire weapons inventor who builds himself a high-tech suit of armor and kicks off the age of heroes.

characters.name: Steve Rogers / Captain America
characters.description: A scrawny kid from Brooklyn turned WWII super-soldier; the moral backbone of the Avengers.

characters.name: Thor
characters.description: The Asgardian God of Thunder, heir to the throne, armed with the enchanted hammer Mjolnir.

characters.name: Bruce Banner / Hulk
characters.description: A brilliant scientist whose gamma-radiation accident turns him into a giant green rage monster whenever he loses control.

characters.name: Natasha Romanoff / Black Widow
characters.description: A former Russian spy and assassin turned S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, working to wipe the red out of her ledger.

characters.name: Clint Barton / Hawkeye
characters.description: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s master archer — the Avenger with no powers, just aim that never misses and a family to protect.

characters.name: Nick Fury
characters.description: Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. and architect of the Avengers Initiative. Always at least three secrets deep.

characters.name: Maria Hill
characters.description: Fury's steely, hyper-competent second-in-command.

characters.name: Phil Coulson
characters.description: The unflappable S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who ties the early films together — and the Avengers' biggest fan.

characters.name: Loki
characters.description: Thor's adopted brother, the God of Mischief — sometimes villain, sometimes ally, always scheming.

characters.name: Sam Wilson / Falcon
characters.description: A pararescue veteran with a winged flight suit, and Steve Rogers' most loyal partner.

characters.name: Bucky Barnes
characters.description: Steve Rogers' childhood best friend and WWII brother-in-arms, whose story doesn't end where the history books say it does.

characters.name: James "Rhodey" Rhodes / War Machine
characters.description: Air Force officer, Tony Stark's best friend, and pilot of his own heavily armed suit of armor.

characters.name: Wanda Maximoff / Scarlet Witch
characters.description: A Sokovian orphan who gained telekinetic and mind-warping powers through HYDRA experiments with the Mind Stone.

characters.name: Pietro Maximoff / Quicksilver
characters.description: Wanda's twin brother, fast enough that the rest of the world seems frozen.

characters.name: Vision
characters.description: A synthetic being born from an AI and the Mind Stone — thoughtful, immensely powerful, and quietly human.

characters.name: Peter Parker / Spider-Man
characters.description: A Queens high-schooler juggling homework and web-slinging, taken under Tony Stark's wing.

characters.name: Stephen Strange / Doctor Strange
characters.description: An arrogant, world-class surgeon who loses the use of his hands and finds the mystic arts instead.

characters.name: T'Challa / Black Panther
characters.description: King and protector of Wakanda, the hidden, hyper-advanced African nation.

characters.name: Carol Danvers / Captain Marvel
characters.description: A U.S. Air Force pilot turned cosmic powerhouse, caught in the middle of an alien war.

characters.name: Scott Lang / Ant-Man
characters.description: An ex-con and well-meaning dad who inherits a suit that can shrink him to insect size.

characters.name: Hope van Dyne / Wasp
characters.description: Hank Pym's fiercely capable daughter, who fights with wings, blasters, and shrinking tech of her own.

characters.name: Shang-Chi
characters.description: A San Francisco valet with a hidden past as the meticulously trained son of a legendary warlord.

characters.name: Kamala Khan / Ms. Marvel
characters.description: A Jersey City teen and Avengers superfan whose grandmother's bangle unlocks cosmic light powers.

characters.name: Jennifer Walters / She-Hulk
characters.description: Bruce Banner's cousin — a lawyer who gets Hulk powers and would really rather just do her job.

characters.name: Marc Spector / Moon Knight
characters.description: A mercenary sharing his body with a mild-mannered gift-shop clerk, serving an Egyptian moon god as its avatar.

characters.name: Kate Bishop
characters.description: A 22-year-old archery prodigy who idolizes Hawkeye and stumbles headfirst into his old mess.

characters.name: Yelena Belova
characters.description: Natasha's little "sister" from her spy days — funnier, arguably deadlier, and done being used.

characters.name: Monica Rambeau
characters.description: Daughter of Carol Danvers' best friend, who grows up to become a S.W.O.R.D. agent with a bigger role ahead of her.

characters.name: America Chavez
characters.description: A teenager with the unique power to punch holes between universes — a power she can't control.

characters.name: Jane Foster
characters.description: The astrophysicist who discovers Thor — and whose story with the hammer isn't over.

characters.name: Valkyrie
characters.description: A hard-drinking former member of Asgard's legendary all-female warrior order.

characters.name: Matt Murdock / Daredevil
characters.description: A blind Hell's Kitchen lawyer with radar-sharp senses and a nighttime hobby.

characters.name: Maya Lopez / Echo
characters.description: A deaf Choctaw enforcer in New York's underworld who can perfectly mirror any fighting style she sees.

characters.name: Riri Williams / Ironheart
characters.description: An MIT genius building her own suit of armor.

characters.name: Cassie Lang
characters.description: Scott's daughter, who grows up idolizing her dad and wanting in on the hero business.

characters.name: Peter Quill / Star-Lord
characters.description: A human abducted from Earth as a kid, now a wisecracking outlaw with a walkman full of '70s hits.

characters.name: Gamora
characters.description: The deadliest woman in the galaxy, raised as a weapon by Thanos and looking for a way out.

characters.name: Drax the Destroyer
characters.description: A relentlessly literal-minded warrior on a quest to avenge his murdered family.

characters.name: Rocket
characters.description: A genetically engineered raccoon: weapons expert, ace pilot, and professional cynic.

characters.name: Groot
characters.description: A walking tree with a three-word vocabulary and a heart bigger than his trunk.

characters.name: Nebula
characters.description: Thanos' other daughter, part machine, driven by rivalry with Gamora and rage at her father.

characters.name: Mantis
characters.description: An empath who can feel and alter emotions with a touch — naive, gentle, and surprisingly funny.

characters.name: Yondu Udonta
characters.description: The blue-skinned Ravager captain who "raised" Peter Quill, armed with a whistle-controlled arrow.

characters.name: Kraglin
characters.description: Yondu's scrappy, endlessly loyal first mate.

characters.name: Adam Warlock
characters.description: A golden artificial being engineered by the Sovereign to be perfect — and decanted a little early.

characters.name: Pepper Potts
characters.description: Tony Stark's indispensable right hand, and the one person who can actually manage him.

characters.name: Happy Hogan
characters.description: Stark's driver, head of security, and reluctant den mother to younger heroes.

characters.name: Peggy Carter
characters.description: A founding agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. and the great love of Steve Rogers' life.

characters.name: Sharon Carter
characters.description: Peggy's niece — a highly trained agent who keeps ending up on the wrong side of official orders.

characters.name: Howard Stark
characters.description: Tony's father: inventor, wartime industrialist, and a founder of S.H.I.E.L.D.

characters.name: Wong
characters.description: Master of the mystic arts and keeper of Kamar-Taj's library — and eventually far more than a sidekick.

characters.name: The Ancient One
characters.description: The enigmatic Sorcerer Supreme who takes Stephen Strange as a student.

characters.name: Karl Mordo
characters.description: A devout master of Kamar-Taj and Strange's first ally in the mystic arts.

characters.name: Heimdall
characters.description: The all-seeing guardian of Asgard's Bifrost bridge.

characters.name: Odin
characters.description: All-Father of Asgard, whose long reign hides some old secrets.

characters.name: Korg
characters.description: A soft-spoken gladiator made of rocks, with a gentle voice and a revolutionary streak.

characters.name: Hank Pym
characters.description: The original Ant-Man — a brilliant, prickly scientist guarding the secret of the Pym Particle.

characters.name: Janet van Dyne
characters.description: Hank's wife and the original Wasp, lost to the Quantum Realm decades ago.

characters.name: Luis
characters.description: Scott's ex-cellmate and business partner, teller of the MCU's most elaborate secondhand stories.

characters.name: Okoye
characters.description: General of the Dora Milaje, Wakanda's elite royal guard, and the definition of loyalty.

characters.name: Shuri
characters.description: T'Challa's little sister and Wakanda's smartest scientist.

characters.name: Nakia
characters.description: A Wakandan spy and T'Challa's former love, who believes Wakanda should open up and help the world.

characters.name: M'Baku
characters.description: Leader of Wakanda's mountain-dwelling Jabari tribe — a rival with his own strict code of honor.

characters.name: Ramonda
characters.description: Queen mother of Wakanda.

characters.name: Everett Ross
characters.description: A sharp CIA agent who keeps finding himself tangled up in Wakandan affairs.

characters.name: Michelle "MJ" Jones
characters.description: Peter Parker's sardonic classmate — far too observant for anyone's good.

characters.name: Ned Leeds
characters.description: Peter's best friend and dedicated "guy in the chair."

characters.name: May Parker
characters.description: Peter's aunt, guardian, and moral compass.

characters.name: Darcy Lewis
characters.description: Jane Foster's snarky intern, eventually a doctor of astrophysics in her own right.

characters.name: Jimmy Woo
characters.description: An earnest FBI agent with close-up magic aspirations.

characters.name: Talos
characters.description: A commander of the shapeshifting alien Skrulls.

characters.name: Katy Chen
characters.description: Shang-Chi's best friend, dragged from parking cars into world-saving.

characters.name: Xu Xialing
characters.description: Shang-Chi's estranged sister, self-taught because no one would train her.

characters.name: Alexei Shostakov / Red Guardian
characters.description: Russia's washed-up super-soldier answer to Captain America — loud, proud, and past his prime.

characters.name: Melina Vostokoff
characters.description: A veteran Black Widow and brilliant scientist from Natasha's fake childhood family.

characters.name: Layla El-Faouly
characters.description: An adventurer and archaeologist tangled up in Marc Spector's past.

characters.name: Mobius
characters.description: A TVA analyst with a soft spot for jet skis and a knack for getting under Loki's skin.

characters.name: Sylvie
characters.description: A dangerous fugitive variant with a lifelong grudge against the TVA.

characters.name: Isaiah Bradley
characters.description: A Black super-soldier from the Korean War era, erased from history.

characters.name: Sersi
characters.description: An Eternal who genuinely loves humanity, living quietly in London until her people's past resurfaces.

characters.name: Ikaris
characters.description: The most powerful of the Eternals — flight, super-strength, and eye-beams.

characters.name: Ajak
characters.description: The Eternals' healer and leader, their only bridge to their creators.

characters.name: Thena
characters.description: The Eternals' greatest warrior, haunted by memories she shouldn't have.

characters.name: Kingo
characters.description: An Eternal hiding in plain sight as a century-spanning "dynasty" of Bollywood stars — all of them him.

characters.name: Agatha Harkness
characters.description: A centuries-old witch with a talent for showing up wherever the magic is.

characters.name: Wilson Fisk / Kingpin
characters.description: New York's brutal, immaculately dressed crime boss.

characters.name: Wade Wilson / Deadpool
characters.description: A fourth-wall-demolishing mercenary with a healing factor and absolutely no filter.

characters.name: Logan / Wolverine
characters.description: A clawed, near-unkillable mutant with a very long list of regrets.

characters.name: Reed Richards / Mister Fantastic
characters.description: The smartest man of his world — an elastic scientist leading Earth's first family of heroes.

characters.name: Sue Storm / Invisible Woman
characters.description: Scientist and diplomat with invisibility and force fields; the family's center of gravity.

characters.name: Johnny Storm / Human Torch
characters.description: Sue's hotheaded — literally — pilot brother.

characters.name: Ben Grimm / The Thing
characters.description: The Fantastic Four's rock-skinned strongman with the softest heart on the team.

characters.name: Silver Surfer
characters.description: A chrome-skinned herald riding ahead of something world-ending.

characters.name: Thanos
characters.description: The Mad Titan — a warlord pursuing all six Infinity Stones with a terrifying sense of purpose.

characters.name: Ultron
characters.description: Tony Stark's peacekeeping AI gone horribly right: it looked at the data and decided humanity was the threat.

characters.name: Hela
characters.description: The Goddess of Death, whose return spells doom for Asgard.

characters.name: Red Skull
characters.description: Head of HYDRA, the Nazi deep-science division, and the first super-soldier experiment gone wrong.

characters.name: Helmut Zemo
characters.description: A meticulous Sokovian mastermind who despises what super-people cost the world.

characters.name: Erik Killmonger
characters.description: A black-ops soldier with a righteous grievance and a claim on Wakanda's throne.

characters.name: Ulysses Klaue
characters.description: A cackling arms dealer and one of the only outsiders to have seen the real Wakanda.

characters.name: Adrian Toomes / Vulture
characters.description: A blue-collar salvager turned winged, high-tech arms dealer.

characters.name: Quentin Beck / Mysterio
characters.description: A caped hero who claims to have come from another Earth.

characters.name: Xu Wenwu
characters.description: The immortal holder of the Ten Rings and leader of the criminal empire named for them — Shang-Chi's father.

characters.name: Gorr the God Butcher
characters.description: A grieving zealot armed with a god-killing blade.

characters.name: Namor
characters.description: The winged-ankled king of a hidden undersea civilization.

characters.name: Kang
characters.description: A conqueror with mastery over time — and countless variants of himself scattered across the multiverse.

characters.name: The High Evolutionary
characters.description: A god-playing scientist obsessed with engineering a perfect society, no matter the cost.

characters.name: Taskmaster
characters.description: A masked operative who can perfectly mimic any fighting style after seeing it once.

characters.name: Ava Starr / Ghost
characters.description: A woman phasing painfully in and out of solid reality thanks to a childhood quantum accident.

characters.name: Emil Blonsky / Abomination
characters.description: A soldier whose super-serum experiment went monstrous — later trying, sincerely or not, to reform.

characters.name: Thaddeus Ross
characters.description: The hard-line general who hunted the Hulk, whose political career keeps on climbing.

characters.name: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine
characters.description: A silky Washington power broker quietly recruiting "assets" for purposes unknown.

characters.name: John Walker
characters.description: The government's hand-picked replacement Captain America — a decorated soldier in over his head.

characters.name: Gravik
characters.description: A young Skrull revolutionary leading a rogue faction that's done waiting for a new homeworld.

characters.name: Cassandra Nova
characters.description: A bald, terrifying telepath ruling a wasteland at the edge of existence.

characters.name: Galactus
characters.description: A cosmic entity that devours entire worlds.

characters.name: Ego
characters.description: Peter Quill's charming, mysterious, very long-lost father.

characters.name: Ronan the Accuser
characters.description: A Kree fanatic wielding a war hammer and an apocalyptic grudge.
